app.name: Slack
app.description: Slack is a channel-based messaging platform for teams to communicate, share files, and integrate with developer tools.

notes: Composio supports two toolkits: **Slack** (user-level auth for workspace actions) and **Slackbot** (bot-level auth for channel messaging and app mentions).
All executed API calls are subject to Composio's standard data encryption and 30-day retention policy.

assumption: An AI agent that reads and sends messages, manages channels, and interacts with files across any customer's Slack workspace

verdict.headline: Slack offers instant self-serve app registration for private workspaces, but public Marketplace publishing requires a formal review.
verdict.summary: Developers can create an app instantly at api.slack.com, configure OAuth scopes, and connect workspaces via custom credentials or direct OAuth install URLs without review. However, publishing to the public Slack Marketplace requires a formal preliminary and functional review process that can take up to several weeks.

handsOnEffort.label: 1–2 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Creating a Slack app, setting redirect URIs, and configuring scopes takes under two hours.

timeToFirstConnection.label: Instant
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Self-serve developer portal allows immediate testing and connection upon app creation.

timeToProduction.label: Instant
timeToProduction.basis: Unlisted distribution via OAuth URLs or custom credentials requires no review gate.

verdict.longestPole: Navigating workspace admin approval settings if the target workspace restricts unlisted apps.
verdict.costDetail: Free developer account and API access across standard Web API tiers.

easierPaths.condition: Using unlisted public distribution via direct OAuth install URL
easierPaths.effect: Bypasses the multi-week Slack Marketplace review process completely.

factors.detail: Any developer can create an app immediately at api.slack.com/apps with a free account.
No review is needed for internal use or unlisted distribution via OAuth URLs; public Marketplace listing requires formal review.
Not required for private apps or unlisted OAuth distribution.
Only required if submitting your app for public Slack Marketplace listing.
Slack API access is included at no additional cost across standard workspace tiers.
No partnership or sales contact is required to build and deploy Slack integrations.
Unlisted distribution via OAuth URLs does not enforce test user caps.
Target workspaces may require admin approval or disabling 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' to install unlisted apps.

phases.title: Register your Slack App
phases.outcome: An unconfigured Slack app record inside your developer account.

steps.title: Create a new app
steps.details: Navigate to the **Slack API Portal**, click **Create New App**, select **From scratch**, enter your app name, and choose your target development workspace.

phases.title: Configure OAuth & Scopes
phases.outcome: OAuth redirect URIs and required permissions configured on your Slack app.

steps.title: Add redirect URL
steps.details: Go to **OAuth & Permissions** in your app settings, locate **Redirect URLs**, click **Add New Redirect URL**, and enter `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`. Click **Save URLs**.
steps.agentAssist: Draft the exact redirect URI string for you to copy and paste.

steps.title: Configure Bot and User Token Scopes
steps.details: Under **OAuth & Permissions**, scroll down to **Scopes**. Add your required bot token scopes (e.g., `chat:write`, `channels:read`, `channels:history`, `search:read`, `channels:write`).
steps.agentAssist: Provide a complete checklist of required scopes matching your agent's intended tool calls.

phases.title: Test with your own account
phases.outcome: Verified OAuth flow working end-to-end within your sandbox workspace.

steps.title: Install app to workspace
steps.details: Navigate to **Basic Information** or **Install App**, click **Install to Workspace**, and authorize the permission prompts.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Slack integrated with Composio using your custom OAuth credentials.

steps.title: Retrieve client credentials
steps.details: Navigate to **Basic Information** in your Slack app console and copy your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

steps.title: Configure custom OAuth in Composio
steps.details: Open your Composio dashboard, navigate to **Custom Auth** for the Slack toolkit, and paste your Slack **Client ID** and **Client Secret**. Save the configuration to generate your custom auth configuration ID.
steps.agentAssist: Generate the API request payload needed to configure custom auth via the Composio API.

requirements.detail: Free account to access api.slack.com/apps and create application records.
A secure callback URL (e.g., https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback) registered in app settings.
Required if the target workspace enforces restrictions against unlisted or non-Marketplace applications.

scopes.purpose: View basic information about public channels in the workspace.
Manage public channels and create new channels.
Send messages on behalf of the app or user.
View messages and other content in public channels.
Search messages and files across the workspace.

blockers.title: Marketplace Restriction Error
blockers.symptom: Users see 'This app isn't listed in the Slack Marketplace' when attempting to authenticate.
blockers.howToProceed: Disable 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' in the target workspace under Settings → Apps & Workflows → App Management Settings.

blockers.title: Admin Approval Prompt
blockers.symptom: Users are blocked and asked to submit an install request to their workspace admin.
blockers.howToProceed: Have a workspace admin approve the app request or disable 'Require approved apps' under the workspace app management settings.

nuances.title: Temporary Code Expiration
nuances.detail: Authorization codes returned by Slack's `/oauth/v2/authorize` endpoint expire in 10 minutes and can only be used once.

nuances.title: Token Rotation & Management
nuances.detail: Slack supports token rotation mechanisms to enhance security for enterprise and standard integrations.

nuances.title: Rate Limit Tiers
nuances.detail: Slack Web API calls are governed by method-specific rate limit tiers (Tiers 1-4 and Special limits) evaluated per workspace.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and open the **Slack** toolkit settings.
Paste your Slack App **Client ID** and **Client Secret** into the designated fields.
Confirm the default scopes or add custom scopes if required.
Save the configuration and pass the resulting auth config ID into your Composio execution sessions.
